storage_contract.operational: SQLite tables (tasks, members, nodes, skills, knowledge sources, event chains)
storage_contract.canonical: tasks + task_events govern task state; skill_bindings + skill_binding_events govern skill bindings. Obsidian remains authoritative for document content.

checks.label: Task acceptance criteria
checks.detail: Define observable outcomes in acceptance criteria for new tasks.

checks.label: Task holder
checks.detail: A task must reference a registered actor for a safe handoff.

checks.label: Task department
checks.detail: dept supports grouping, routing, and reporting; it may initially be empty.

checks.label: Task evidence references
checks.detail: refs link documents, deliverables, or external evidence without copying their content.

checks.label: Execution worker runtimes
checks.detail: Only execution workers need a runtime, used for matching, session mapping, and node health checks.

checks.label: Human role entry points
checks.detail: Human roles register a contact entry or node; they do not represent model runtimes.

checks.label: Session metadata index
checks.detail: Sync only explicitly authorized metadata, summaries, or sanitized messages. The runtime remains authoritative for session content.

checks.label: Standard pipeline templates
checks.detail: Keep at least three reusable workflows: handouts, development delivery, and knowledge organization.

checks.label: Task event chain
checks.detail: The event chain audits state changes; it is not independently written alongside the board.

health.history_policy: Historical sessions, usage, and task events are retained. Freshness alerts neither rewrite history nor establish execution acceptance.

checks.label: Device and model registration
checks.detail: Check enabled model workers only; index services are excluded. Registered models still require runtime evidence.

checks.label: Possible duplicate workers
checks.detail: Review multiple identities sharing a device, runtime, and registered model; identities are not automatically merged or revoked.

checks.label: Node report receipt
checks.detail: The latest recorded time may come from a heartbeat or runtime scan. It proves receipt of a node report, not fresh hardware telemetry or active model execution.

checks.label: Runtime scan sources
checks.detail: Check freshness using the latest recorded runtime scan. A scan does not prove active model execution.

checks.label: Holder identities for unfinished tasks
checks.detail: Tasks held by disabled actors or index services need a reviewed handoff. Historical tasks remain unchanged.

checks.label: Execution leases for unfinished tasks
checks.detail: An expired lease means execution authorization expired. It does not imply failure or trigger completion, reruns, or handoffs.

checks.label: Session index sync sources
checks.detail: Check existing sources by sync time. Session activity and historical usage dates do not establish sync failures. A missing source does not mean no work occurred.

checks.label: Usage sync sources
checks.detail: Check existing sources by sync time. Session activity and historical usage dates do not establish sync failures. A missing source does not mean no work occurred.

checks.label: Historical session index sources
checks.detail: Administrator-classified historical sources remain visible and do not count as healthy current sources. A newer report for the same identity and runtime returns the source to current sync checks.

recommendations: Add verifiable acceptance criteria to four task cards.
The session index is empty. Connect metadata indexing first, without importing session content.
Fewer than three workflow templates. Add reusable templates for handouts, development delivery, and knowledge organization.
Four operational records need review. Check source times, expired leases, and identity registration in Data quality. Historical records remain retained.

privacy.web_catalog: Returns only fields, counts, status, and catalog metadata
